theorems.name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailBinPrefix_of_cylinder
theorems.role: Literal arbitrary nonroot first-pile cylinder adapter
theorems.source: lem:ub-conditional-first-moment (final cylinders); exact reservoir tail-bin convention
theorems.inputs: A nonroot prefix and the statement that all full extensions have first digit p; no probability or legal-word assumption
theorems.output: Existential E and actual tail word v with equality tailBinPrefix E p v=x; constructed E=x.length-1

theorems.name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count
theorems.role: Actual conditional vertex-count bound for tiny final cylinders

theorems.name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCylinder_collisions
theorems.role: Actual conditional full-word collision count in intermediate final cylinders

boundary_checks: Nonroot assumption enforces a literal first digit and permits E=length-1; one-digit prefix has E=0.
Full-length prefixes produce the full tail word; all tail product conventions remain exact.
Prefix extension exists even at zero mass, so whole-cylinder pile containment is not vacuous.
Tiny mean may vanish; only nonnegative real powers are used.
Intermediate lower mean is strictly positive because n>=2, and maximal tail bounds use that actual regime.
Direction-dependent future inequalities are strict and relative to the actual sorted current word at pilePosition.
The conditioning event is exactly historyFiber at j+1 in the same direction, with positiveHistory explicit.
Forward and backward constants and thresholds are combined before all population, array, regime, history and prefix parameters.
The collision sum is literally over all full words in the chosen cylinder, with natural choose2 counts.
No graph edge comparison, Jensen step, final C, or terminal premise discharge is asserted by these helpers.
